Eye_DR.description: Diabetic retinopathy — retinal blood vessel damage from diabetes

Eye_Glaucoma.description: Optic nerve damage usually from elevated eye pressure

Eye_Maculopathy.description: Damage to the macula — central vision affected

Eye_Vascular.description: Retinal vascular occlusions — blocked blood vessels in retina

Eye_Degeneration.description: Retinal degeneration conditions including RP and pathological myopia
Eye_Degeneration.treatment: Low vision aids, gene therapy (some), photoprotection

Eye_OCT.description: Conditions identified on OCT: AMD, DME, ERM and others
Eye_OCT.treatment: Depends on specific condition — anti-VEGF, observation

Eye_Cornea.treatment: Antibiotics, antifungals, corneal transplant if severe

Eye_Other.description: Other retinal conditions including ERM, macular hole, disc abnormalities
Eye_Other.treatment: Surgery (vitrectomy for ERM/MH), observation for others
